<thought>To obtain the precursors, I need the specific template ID that was identified in the previous task (make_8_lvl2‑template_search‑5). Since the exact ID isn’t provided in the current context, I will search the template catalog for a Wolff‑Kishner‑type transformation, which in the forward direction breaks a ketone (functional group “ketones”) and forms an alkane. I will search for templates that break a C=O bond in a ketone.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
